frozen_law.scope: Conservative material-role rule for this explicitly conditional black-chicken family, not a single-ingredient substitution or invariant full operation graph.
constructors: BASE(primary gingerbread) = burned gingerbread, with local pounding/cooling operations as each witness actually states.
BASE(alternate honey+flour) = honey+flour burned in pan until black, with local pounding/cooling operations as each witness actually states.
Common suffix: STRAIN/PASS(BASE, with eggs) -> POUR/COAT(result, chickens). Black chickens retain GOLD-clove garnish; other colors retain their independently stated garnish branches.
frozen_law.propagation: At the reconvergence, later its/it or null input must refer to the chosen prepared base and then its egg-preparation result. Substitution changes both downstream material arguments, not chicken identity, egg identity, cloth identity or gold-clove identity. The primary gingerbread cannot silently remain an input on the unavailable-gingerbread path.

predictions_for_w1_7.assertion: Complete unit names black chickens and offers honey+flour conditional on lacking gingerbread, rather than requiring all three.
Both alternatives converge on a passed/strained preparation with eggs which is poured onto the same chickens.
Black chickens, rather than the alternate coating material, receive gold cloves; other color garnish instructions may be locally different or absent.
A claimed full invariant operation law is stronger than this law; record actual cooling/pounding/cloth/roasting scope and do not normalize differences away.

disconfirmers: Alternative feeds another object/output, leaves primary gingerbread required, or substitutes for eggs/garnish instead of base.
Complete unit lacks common egg-preparation/chicken application or directs these to a different material.
Gold-clove dependent role differs or is absent: P3 fails or is underspecified; no postread repair.

Local third comparison is not independent confirmation. Institutional catalogue W1 opened for provenance; body not returned/read before law.

role_model.primary_base: BURN(gingerbread); mortar pounding where explicitly stated.
role_model.alternate_base: BURN_IN_PAN(MIX(honey, flour), UNTIL_BLACK); cooling where explicitly stated. MIX is implicit joint material composition, not an additional written mixing verb.
role_model.common_preparation: PASS/STRAIN(chosen prepared base, with eggs); B4/W1 specify cloth, GR1 does not. Exact order of mixing eggs and straining is underdetermined by mit.
role_model.application: POUR(common preparation, same chickens). Does not specify fresh chicken entities, numbers or portions.
role_model.later_condition: B4/W1 WHEN_ROASTED(chickens) -> STUD(chickens, cloves), color-dependent decoration. GR1 says do as written before and stud with gold cloves.
role_model.decoration: BLACK -> gold(en) cloves; RED -> silver(en) cloves; GREEN -> silver+gold; GR1 additionally WHITE -> black. These are decoration roles, not coating-base ingredients. Metal-coating technique is not established.
